address: 49 Frith Street, Soho, London, W1D 4SG, United Kingdom
bio: Street food inspired by Tamil Nadu and Sri Lanka features at this fun little spot from the Sethi family, who also own Trishna and Gymkhana. The 'hoppers' – bowl-shaped pancakes made from fermented rice and coconut – are ideal with a creamy kari. The ‘short eats’ and the prices are great too....
